videos.title: YouTube videos
videos.description: Video URLs or 11-character video IDs. Works with watch, youtu.be, Shorts, embed and live links. Duplicates are fetched once.

languages.title: Preferred languages
languages.description: Language codes in order of preference (for example en, pt, es). The first one the video has wins; captions written by a person are preferred over auto-generated ones.

fallbackToAnyLanguage.title: Fall back to any language
fallbackToAnyLanguage.description: If the video has none of the preferred languages, return the transcript it does have instead of an error.

includeSegments.title: Include timestamped segments
includeSegments.description: Also return the transcript split into segments with start time and duration in seconds. The full text is always returned.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many videos are fetched at the same time.
